raw_segments.text: Fluiline, by your patience, and sheant pistol.
Fortune is painted blind with a muffler afore his eyes to signify to you that Fortune is
blind, and she is painted also with a wheel to signify to you which is the moral of it
that she is turning and in constant and mutability and variation, and her foot look you is fixed
upon a spherical stone which rolls and rolls and rolls.
In good truth, the poet makes a most excellent description of it.
